newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schaeuble sees better chance for tax pact with SPD.
newsitem.headline: Schaeuble sees better chance for tax pact with SPD.

text.p: Wolfgang Schaeuble, Chancellor Helmut Kohl's heir apparent and tax negotiator for Germany's Christian Democrats (CDU), said on Friday after meeting with opposition leaders that chances for a tax agreement had improved.

"We look with great optimism to the further talks," Schaeuble said. "The way is long and will require great efforts, but the chances of reaching an agreement enabling us to fight unemployment have increased."
